evidence.name: Screen field: Rounding the icon corners
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Rounding the icon corners" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Rounding the icon corners
sections.description: Rounds the corners of the icon image (0-50px, default 0 for square). Leave it at 0 for normal line or glyph icons; raise it only for a photo or avatar-style icon you want to soften or make circular. It has little visible effect on transparent line icons, so most fields can skip it.
